mainWindow.description: Main editor window. Title contains the editor name in the current UI language.

editArea.description: Text editing area. Classic Notepad: Edit (no automationId). Windows 11 Notepad: RichEditD2DPT Document. Notepad3: Scintilla Pane, which exposes NO ValuePattern - use type_text/send_key instead of setValue.

statusBar.description: Optional status bar (absent on some editors).
